decisions.statement: A sentence built from rows for a test is built here rather than by each test.
A token is numbered by its place in its sentence.
A head of zero names the root.
An offset is an index into the whole document rather than into one sentence.
A relation is matched by its own name or by the name before its colon.
A tie between two heads is broken toward the lower token.
A cycle is broken by the swap that costs the least score.
A token the model built carries how sure the model was of each class.
A confidence is the chance the model gave the class the model chose.
A token built by hand has no confidence.

definition: the tree a sentence's words make
